title: A Journey through States of Water
introduction: A Journey through States of Water is explored through questions about A Journey through States of Water, observation, reasoning, application, evidence, reflection. Learners observe patterns, distinguish evidence from assumptions, build explanations, use simple investigations and connect the ideas to familiar surroundings.
